title: lifecycle-invariants.json names cloud/factory/** for today-sites; consumers now map
body: The pinned bundle's `today` and threshold `file` paths say cloud/factory/..., while ticfac's copy lives at ticfac/cloudflare; l9n added a reader-side mapping (contractSourcePath in internal/factory/lifecycle/contract_test.go) and the contract itself was correctly left untouched. When the next bundle version is cut, decide whether those paths should stay canonical-as-ticks (and the mapping becomes the documented permanent shape) or carry a location-neutral spelling - recording it now avoids a second consumer re-deriving the mapping independently.
